points.description: States that the cause/reason is an open path (e.g. a path or route left open/unblocked, allowing something to pass or connect through it). Equivalent wording such as 'a path was left open' or 'the route was not blocked' earns the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for identifying that an open path was the reason, in any equivalent wording. No mark if the answer gives a different cause or only describes the event without identifying the open path as the reason.
